help.q1: How do I place an order?
help.a1: Add items to your cart, then confirm with cash on delivery (COD). You pay when you receive it.
help.q2: How do I become a vendor?
help.a2: Go to Profile → Become a vendor, fill in your shop details: it's activated right away.
help.q3: How do I get the verified badge?
help.a3: The badge appears once your identity is verified, your phone confirmed, your shop photo added and at least one product posted.
